experiments.title: Inspect April 2018/2019 valley maps already produced
experiments.host: Mac or any host with prediction files / published figures
protocol: Read figures/input_brief/april2019_t2m.png and april2019_precip.png (already in repo).
If available, load runs/det_v1/prediction_val_* for 2018-04-15 and 2019-04-15 (not in git; on train host).
Record for each week: is valley too warm vs obs? Does issue-week field already show the cold?
Write april_map_notes.md in this run directory — no training.
experiments.success_criterion: Written note classifying warm-bias vs flat vs other for Apr 2018 and Apr 2019.

experiments.title: Tabulate issue-week vs model vs historical week for April only
experiments.host: GPU cluster or Frontier where check_scores / predictions exist
protocol: From existing score JSON or recompute from predictions: valley T RMSE for issue week, det_v1, det_v2_ps, climatology on 2018-04-15 and 2019-04-15.
Do not retrain. Append numbers only from files into april_score_slice.json.
experiments.success_criterion: Table exists with file-backed numbers; confirms or rejects that issue week beats the model on both Aprils.

experiments.title: Cut 15 Mar / 1 Apr / 1 May examples (after E1)
protocol: Only if E1 suggests the miss may be season-wide or PI wants the ambiguity resolved.
Build additional issue dates whose target week stays in one month (TRAINING_DATA_DESIGN).
Score with frozen det_v1 recipe or document that a retrain is required — PI chooses.
Compare valley T vs historical week on 2018–2019 for those dates.
experiments.success_criterion: Clear statement: 16–22 Apr-only vs spring-wide miss.

experiments.title: Collection augmenter: propose 2–3 April/SE cold-week papers
protocol: After E1 notes exist, run collection.augment propose-only.
Human approves keys before catalog/PDF ingest.
No web dump into pdfs/ without gate.
experiments.success_criterion: Approved catalog rows linked to april_cold_week_mechanism.
